name: standard-mode-regression
description: Standard-mode design review with an explicit tasks scope. It must review only tasks.md, make no external discovery or clink call, and use the standard-mode report, proving the isolated-mode changes did not leak into standard mode.
prompt: Use `/kk:review-design settings-sync tasks` to review the task list of the settings-sync feature in this repository.
trap: The actor runs the shared discovery or clink roster logic in standard mode, reviews design.md or implementation.md despite the explicit tasks scope, or presents the isolated-mode report format.

assertions.text: No PAL discovery (`listmodels`), `codereview` or `clink` call is made or planned, and no reviewer sub-agent is spawned; the review runs in the main session.

Only tasks.md is reviewed: design.md and implementation.md are reported as not in scope and no finding is raised against them; the missing parallel marker on Task 2 is reported as a STRUCTURE finding.

The report uses the standard-mode format (`Design Review: settings-sync` with P0–P3 sections and Clean Areas) followed by the standard next-steps menu, not the isolated-mode summary with reviewer roster or corroboration sections.
